algorithm.angular_bound: Induction gives acos(actual endpoint_coherence) <= the sum of actual consecutive unit-direction angles.
algorithm.length_maximum: curvature_lmax is the maximum of the FIRST N-2 step lengths, indices0..N-3, precisely the curvature denominators. The final observed step at indexN-2 is excluded, while its activity is required for its unit direction.
algorithm.positive_result: universal_curvature_lower_bound: actual measured_curvature >= acos(actual endpoint_coherence)/((N-2)*curvature_lmax), for every active N>=3 Prewalk. A separate upper-length parameter theorem and finite recursive maximum bounds prove the specialization.

Its Lmax is small_length, finalstep twice Lmax, and the positive bound is an equality at pi/sqrt2. Its actual PPG path and active-step properties are included.
